regions.region: page 1 title, abstract, author block, and SI availability sentence
regions.finding: Verified the source-derived article title and aggregate 90–98% ee claim. Although the article links online Supporting Information, workspace source mapping leaves SI association unestablished, so no SI fact was imported.
Nine cited prior methods were identified from the prose and linked to the nine Scheme 1 arrows on page 2. They are literature examples rather than current-paper experiments.
The new Pd/(R)- or (S)-L5 alkoxycarbonylation is introduced as a generic method and continues as Scheme 2 on page 2; row-specific experiments are recorded separately.

unresolved: Scheme 1 prior-work structures contain generic R groups and do not define unique compounds or complete operations.

regions.finding: All nine prior-literature arrows were visually inspected and retained separately with displayed outcome ranges where legible; generic structures and missing operations remain unresolved.
Classified the racemic carbonate to enantioenriched allenoate drawing as a general current-method scheme, not a single experimental run.

regions.region: page 2 lower narrative ligand and solvent optimization
regions.finding: The prose maps to Table 1 and Table 2 rows on page 3. It confirms trace/mostly-unreacted behavior, 24 h for the model reaction, and identifies the optimal 3 mol% Pd/9 mol% L5 system without creating duplicate prose-only records.

unresolved: Operational workup/purification details for optimization rows are not printed on this page.

regions.region: page 3 upper-left Table 1 ligand-effect rows 1–7 and footnotes
regions.finding: Seven ligand-screen rows were retained with row-specific scale/loadings, NMR versus isolated yield bases, ee dashes, recovery/N.D., and internal-standard/HPLC bases. Entry 5 is a reference-15 comparator; entry 7 is merged with identical Table 2 entry 1.

regions.region: page 3 lower-left Table 2 optimization rows 1–8 and footnotes
regions.finding: Eight conditions were retained, with Table 1 entry 7/Table 2 entry 1 represented once. The cinnamyl-Pd override, solvent identities, isolated versus NMR outcomes, source dashes, N.D. values, and recoveries were structured.

regions.region: page 3 right Table 3 substrate-scope rows and footnotes
regions.finding: Twenty distinct rows were retained. Temperature/time overrides, ECNU-Phos reference-15 comparator rows, recovered starting material values, isolated yields, and HPLC ee values remain row-specific.

unresolved: Compact substituent tables do not safely define all stereochemical SMILES candidates.
Most rows omit isolated masses, workups, and purifications.
ECNU-Phos comparator rows are prior literature rather than new current-paper runs.

regions.region: page 4 upper-left Table 4 rows 1–10b and footnotes
regions.finding: Sixteen distinct alkyl-substrate rows were retained with 20 °C overrides, current L5 versus cited ECNU-Phos conditions, isolated yields, HPLC ee, and NMR starting-material recoveries.
A separate 4 h kinetic-resolution experiment gives (Ra)-2t in 12%/90% ee and recovered (Sa)-1t in 67%/15% ee; it is not merged with the 24 h Table 4 entry 4.
Four (S)-L5 experiments furnishing (Sa)-2a, 2c, 2n, and 2o were retained separately from their (R)-ligand counterparts.
The 5 mmol (±)-1a scale-up gives (Ra)-2a in 88% yield and 97% ee and is merged with the detailed page-5 Experimental Section.
Five application experiments were identified: iodolactonization, DIBAL-H reduction, allylmagnesium addition, and two separate diethylzinc cyclizations for methyl/ethyl esters.

unresolved: Table 4 current rows at 20 °C refer to unassociated SI for 25 °C data; those SI values were not inferred.
Scheme 3 and Scheme 4 omit many absolute charges and operational details.

regions.region: page 5 upper-left continuation of Scheme 4 discussion
regions.finding: The prose confirms 5a at 80%/95% ee and 6a/6b at 87%/93% ee after 2.5 h; it is linked to the five Scheme 4 arrow records rather than duplicated.

The 5 mmol scale-up was enriched with exact Pd/L5/LiF/1a/toluene charges, ordered argon and CO gas exchanges, 1 h room-temperature precatalyst stir, 25 °C/24 h hold, workup, chromatography, 1.0129 g/88%, and full HPLC ee basis.
Qi Liu and Hui Qian are thanked for reproducing 2c, 2m, and 2y results. No independent charges, conditions, outcomes, or run identifiers are supplied, so no duplicate records were created.
Bibliography and reviews are not expanded into current-paper experiments beyond the explicit Scheme 1 literature examples.

unresolved: The reproduction acknowledgment does not identify separable runs.
Several gas-exchange/addition/ramp durations in the scale-up are not reported.

regions.finding: The page contains bibliography and a catalyst-price note only. No current reaction arrow, table row, experimental operation, product outcome, or associated SI file appears.

regions.region: page 6 manuscript history and editorial note
regions.finding: Publication metadata and the Early View correction notice contain no reaction experiment.

unresolved: No reaction record is assigned to this bibliography-only page.
External cited papers were not imported as experiments of the current document.
